output.reason: The linked PR [ev-67b7b11a8f02] explains the mechanism. Once CRDs became owned by the provider, the MRD lost its controller owner reference on the CRD. controller-runtime's builder.Owns only matches controller owners unless an extra option is set, so the MRD reconciler's watch on CRDs stopped matching. The fix in internal/controller/apiextensions/managed/setup.go [ev-9b8be0ed463d] removes that controller-only filter. MRDs, the MRD reconciler and CRD-to-MRD conversion all ship new in this same release [ev-47653e3e1ebb][ev-543a22471270][ev-2c984df9c0e9], so this reads as an internal fix to the 2.0 MRD controller's watches: it applies to installs where the MRD controller manages provider CRDs, has no user configuration, and needs no operator action. I'm only moderately sure because the consequence (the watch no longer drops CRD events) comes from the PR's explanation, not from an explicit impact statement.
